Asha (Sec): FYI — security advisory: we are deprecating long‑lived service keys and requiring OIDC short‑lived tokens for service-to-service auth. Migration deadline: 2026-04-15. Please read and act.
Tom (Infra): Is this for all envs (prod/stage/dev)?
Asha (Sec): All envs. Devs can use temporary exceptions (see below) but prod must be migrated by deadline. Reason: leaked keys in past scans + better auditable rotation with OIDC.
Priya (DevEx): Do we have a migration playbook? Links?
Marta (Platform): Uploaded a draft runbook to the internal docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/oidc-migration (link). High level steps in the runbook: 1) create workload identity provider, 2) update service account config, 3) issue short token, 4) validate.
Tom (Infra): Example for k8s workloads:
```
# update deployment annotation to use workload identity
kubectl annotate serviceaccount my-app iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account=project-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# verify token issuance
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /var/run/secrets/tokens/oidc)" https://internal-api/health
```
Priya (DevEx): Can we add a CLI helper? I can ship a small tool that wraps validation and prints migration checklist.
Asha (Sec): Please do. Priya — assign to yourself and drop a PR to infra/tools.
Priya (DevEx): On it. ETA EOW.
Tom (Infra): What about CI / deploy keys that currently use static tokens? We have ~12 pipelines.
Asha (Sec): CI pipelines must switch to ephemeral OIDC tokens or use short‑lived machine tokens stored in Vault with automatic rotation. We've flagged all pipelines under ticket SEC-4239.
sre-oncall: Any runbook for rollback? If something breaks during rollout, how do we quickly revert?
Marta (Platform): Rollback plan: re-enable the legacy key via a one-time emergency token (audited + time‑boxed) — sec-bot will record the re-enable event automatically. We're trying to avoid this but it's available.
sec-bot: Automated scan scheduled: weekly leak-scan and key-usage-report. Running initial inventory now. Report will be posted in #eng-security.
Asha (Sec): Action items: 1) owners of services update configs to OIDC by Apr 15. 2) update CI to request tokens or use Vault short-lived creds. 3) run validation script and paste output into SEC-4239. 4) request exception (with justification) if you truly cannot migrate. No more ad-hoc long-lived keys.
Tom (Infra): Noted. I'll start with core infra services and list owners in SEC-4239.
Priya (DevEx): I'll open PR for the CLI helper + add validation step to the quickstart templates.
Marta (Platform): I'll schedule a migration office hours next Tue 10am PT to help teams.
Asha (Sec): Thanks. If you hit blockers tag me or escalate to sec-oncall. Noncompliance after Apr 15 will trigger automated key revocation and a security review.
Priya (DevEx): Quick Q — how do we prove we've migrated? Where to paste evidence?
Asha (Sec): Paste the validation output + deployment manifest diff into SEC-4239. We'll run an automated check and mark the service as migrated.
Tom (Infra): Understood. Starting inventory now.
sre-oncall: I'll monitor for alerts during mass rollouts and keep the incident channel ready.
Asha (Sec): Final reminder: deadline 2026-04-15. If you're unclear, join the office hours or ping me. :lock:
